horoscope: Mercury moves into your work and health sector today, dear Aries, and you're gearing up to get some sorting and organizing done. Lasting until September 10th, this cycle is excellent for attention to detail, running errands, and organizing your work and routines. The technical side of a topic may appeal to you now. You may gather information related to diet and health, or specialized disciplines can thrive now. Watch for a tendency to over-analyze and criticize during this cycle. Favored now are activities that get your life and your mind tidy and organized. Today's transits are good for opening you up. It’s a time for making the most of what you have or own, whether it’s a latent talent, knowledge, or material good. You could be solving other people’s problems–it feels good to do so, and it might also lead to solving one of your own. Because you’re looking in places you usually would overlook on a regular day, you might find a lost item or the missing piece to a puzzle, or even a resource you didn’t know was yours.

Mercury heads into your sector of joy today, dear Taurus, putting you in the mood for some fun and games. Mercury will visit here until September 10th, and in the weeks ahead, you'll take a greater interest in creative expression, the technical side of creative projects, and arts and crafts or hobbies. Intellectual creativity can be in strong focus. Relationships can be very verbal, and people more often find your ideas appealing. Activities that let you have fun, impress, create, and share are strongly in focus. Today may bring productive communication or reflection. A Mercury-Chiron aspect boosts clarity and self-expression. You are more willing to listen, absorb, and explain. You have a unique or different view of life, and this trait stands out today. Good opportunities for personal appeal and expression can emerge, and having fun or being creative seems the best way to open them up. Others find you pleasingly attractive and wise. This can be a good time for creating, sharing, and connecting.

Mercury heads into your home and family sector today, dear Gemini, awakening a need for extra rest, time at home or with loved ones, and familiar places and faces. This transit lasts until September 10th, and it can mean you're talking and thinking about (and with) family far more than usual in the coming weeks, or that there's more activity in your home environment. Today's Mercury-Chiron trine helps you take stock of what is and isn’t working in your life. Conversations that help heal and repair the rough edges in a relationship can figure strongly. With this transit's help, you might arrive at diplomatic solutions to problems organically. Certainly, being more patient and willing to take extra time to listen, absorb, and explain can boost your interactions.

Mercury moves into your communication sector today, dear Cancer. Until September 10th, you're in particularly good shape for learning new things and brushing up on skills, connecting with the information you need or want, and making contacts. This transit highlights your desire to talk, share, learn, and connect. Keeping and getting in touch with others can benefit you. You're in a strong cycle for gathering information. It's a busy time -- mostly comfortably so, although sometimes you might feel the pace gets hectic. Today's energies help enhance existing connections. You can feel inspired to enjoy and express yourself. There can be a lot to learn or share, and conversations tend to flow quite nicely. It’s a good day for opening up discussions. People readily lean on you, and you’re happy to oblige.

Mercury enters your solar second house today and will visit until September 10th, dear Leo. You're in good shape to sort out your financial affairs and business matters during this cycle. The second house reflects your talents and potential sources of income, and Mercury here finds ways to put these resources to good use. You may be able to make money through communicating, teaching, publishing, and connecting. This can be a time to clarify your financial position, self-worth, or fundamental values. It's also a time for working smartly. You put far more thought than usual into business and finances as well as matters of comfort and security. Today, a conversation could lift your spirits, or new insight into a problem can surface. A Mercury-Chiron aspect helps you communicate flowingly. Your ability to listen and share helps put others at ease, promoting open and satisfying, two-way conversations. You feel empowered by the truth, and you’re approaching it mindfully. Regarding discussions, you’re ready to take on a challenge and more inclined to explore topics you might skirt on an ordinary day. Money matters are in favor, such as a repaid debt or a gift received.

Mercury enters your sign today, dear Virgo, and will visit until September 10th. This Mercury transit encourages you to share more by talking, writing, and connecting with others. It's nevertheless a rather independent time, as you tend to be a self-starter, and you often make executive decisions during this cycle. You might benefit from doing some self-directed learning during this period. As you go forward, decisions come far more confidently than they have in recent weeks. Today, conversations can be particularly enjoyable as Mercury harmonizes with healer Chiron. This influence encourages you to express yourself, and others receive your communications well. Best of all, you’re feeling comfortable with your words or intentions. You might especially enjoy connecting, sharing, or promoting now. You successfully envision solutions and develop strategies for dealing with problems or achieving your long-term goals. If you can focus your energies on something fun rather than routine, you can do particularly well. Others appreciate your perspective.

Mercury moves into the sign just behind yours, dear Libra, and getting some extra time for mental healing and renewal can do you wonders. Mercury will visit this area of your solar chart until September 10th, and during this cycle, decision-making can be more solitary as you're inclined to do more ruminating than usual. You tend to spend more time in your own world. It's a strong time to see your life differently, which rounds out your understanding. Closing up a special project can be in focus. Your ability to view past matters in a new light can be most useful today. Help can come from behind the scenes or through an illuminating conversation. Someone may have your back. Mercury harmonizes with Chiron in your intimacy sector, throwing a compassionate light on a matter. Your ideas may be catching on, or your attitude is appreciated. This transit might also help resolve an issue related to debt or closure.

Mercury's move into your social sector today gives you some reason to take your mind off problems, dear Scorpio. Until September 10th, involvement with others or friend connections can pick up pace. It can be an excellent time for objective thinking and decision-making. Communications with friends, associates, or groups increase. There can be a stronger mental focus on long-term happiness goals, social life, and contributions. People can be especially interested in your ideas and input during this gently boosting cycle. Today, you instinctively know what works and matters. The lines of communication are open! Making repairs in a relationship through discussion or connecting more deeply with a partner or special friend can be in focus. You recognize that true power can never be won or lost, as it comes from within.

Mercury heads to the top of your solar chart today, dear Sagittarius, and your responsibilities and goals are in stronger focus. This transit, lasting until September 10th, turns your thoughts more frequently to your responsibilities, plans, work, and reputation. You're more accountable for what you communicate, and you may take the lead in a particular field or with a unique project. There could be new goals or lifestyle changes entertained during this cycle. Today, talking about your needs and concerns with someone you care about can be refreshing. It’s a time to benefit from catching up with loved ones or your heart. Conversations about work or health matters can also be helpful. Good energy is with you for solving a practical problem or for work plans coming together. It can be a good time to present an idea.

Mercury moves into your sector of spirit and adventure today, dear Capricorn. Your non-material goals are assuming more and more importance. A breath of fresh air is vital for your emotional well-being during this transit that lasts until September 10th. It eases self-expression and smooths out communications. It's an ideal time to teach, disseminate knowledge, share ideas, broadcast, publish, and otherwise spread the word. You're inclined to explore new interests or broaden your knowledge now. Today, conversations can be revealing as you click not only on practical levels but also on physical and emotional ones. Sharing ideas can be pleasant and instructive. This can be a powerful day for learning and discovery and perhaps a boost to a friendship. You might contribute something unique to a group or share your expertise, which can eventually lead to advancement.

Mercury moves into your solar eighth house today, dear Aquarius, and will visit until September 10th. This new transit puts you in a great position to think and talk through matters of sharing, finances, psychology, and intimacy. You might throw yourself into a special project or research a matter further. With some moderation, this can be a powerful time to move a project along or learn important things about yourself and your relationships. You are picking up a lot more from your environment than usual, and seeing motives, subtleties, and power dynamics. Today, family interactions can be revealing, supportive, and insightful, and conversations are more constructive than usual. Learning something new about yourself can be useful and point you in a positive, happy direction.

Mercury moves into your partnership sector today, dear Pisces, where it will visit until September 10th. This sector, found at the opposite side of your solar chart, challenges you to see your life from a different perspective. A partner or good friend can be in stronger focus, and your desire for companionship or feedback increases. This transit brings a stronger tendency to consider others' ideas and decisions, and perhaps attract talkative people into your life. Or, it can be a period when you seek an intellectual companion. Communication takes on far greater importance in your life. It's a good time for counseling and advising, and you'll find that conversations with others tend to jumpstart your thinking processes. Today, conversations can bring new insight into a relationship or help you understand different communication styles. It’s a fine time to listen and be heard. Discussions can feel healing and magical, and they may even elevate a connection.
